content:
margot: Partner reported a throughput regression after their infra upgrade on GCP (NVIDIA P4s). Seeing ~15% token/sec drop when they moved to CUDA 12.2 + driver 535. Can we triage and decide on a recommended pin? cc @henry @tariq

henry: Confirmed. Reproduced a small perf dip in our internal perf harness. Not a crash, but p95 latency up and tokens/s down.

tariq: Repro on staging. Profiling shows extra kernel launch stalls and memcpy overhead; suspected scheduling change in driver/runtime. I can share nvprof traces and a tiny reproduce script.

suzie: Any pattern by sequence length or batch size? Could be attention kernel fallback for short sequences.

tariq: Good catch. This is worse at batch=1, seq<=512. Larger batches mask it. nvprof snippet below.

```
# nvprof (short) -> attribution
multi_head_attn_forward  avg 1.7ms -> 2.1ms
H2D memcpy +20us
cuBLAS small-matmul algo fallback observed
```

henry: Partner wants an official marketplace guidance: a pinned driver/CUDA combo that we verify for inference images so auto-upgrades don't surprise them.

margot: Short-term proposal: publish a "Verified for inference" marketplace image pinned to CUDA 12.1 + NVIDIA driver 525, and mark CUDA12.2/535 as experimental until we confirm vendor fix. Meanwhile eng tries mitigations.

oliver: Agree on a verified matrix for marketplace. Also need comms copy to explain rollback steps and managed vs self-hosted differences.

tariq: Immediate mitigation I can try: force deterministic kernels and tweak copy overlap. Quick runtime patch prototype below; will canary it.

```
# runtime_patch.conf
INFER_KERNEL_MODE=deterministic
COPY_OVERLAP=2
CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:16:8
```

henry: We'll ask partners to either use the pinned image or apply the runtime patch. I'll draft partner-facing text.

suzie: I'll run a perf sweep across seq lengths and batch sizes, and include ROCm permutations. Early ROCm check: rocm-5.4 looks fine; rocm-5.5 beta shows some noise.

margot: Action items:
- henry: Draft partner message + outreach; recommend pinned CUDA12.1/driver525 image and include rollback steps (ETA 2h)
- tariq: Publish nvprof traces, reproduce script, and runtime patch (ETA EOD)
- suzie: Full perf matrix including ROCm (ETA tomorrow)
- oliver: Update marketplace listing with "Verified for inference" badge and stack matrix (ETA tomorrow)

deploy-bot: canary-deploy/runtime-patch started by tariq 11 canary instances stg-a1, stg-a4, stg-a7

tariq: Canary results: p95 improved ~9% (close to target). More runs underway. Will attach numbers to the internal ticket.

suzie: Full sweep aligns with canary. ROCm unaffected for now.

henry: Partner messaging draft: "We detected a perf regression with CUDA 12.2 + NVIDIA driver 535 on certain VM types. Short-term options: 1) use our 'Verified for inference' image pinned to CUDA 12.1 + driver 525 (link), or 2) apply our runtime patch (instructions). We're working with vendor engineering on a driver fix. We'll update when available."

margot: Add estimated customer impact and a rollback checklist. Distinguish instructions for managed customers vs marketplace image users.

oliver: If >3 partners are impacted we'll run a quick partner webinar. For now targeted outreach.

henry: Opened partner ticket PT-3941 with logs and contact. Will update after vendor feedback.

margot: Closing loop here for now; will reopen thread if vendor provides a driver hotfix or if regression widens. :thumbsup:
